description: Wendler 5/3/1 full 4-week cycle with all 4 main lifts

workouts.note: Week 1 Workout 1: All 4 lifts at 65/75/85% TM (5-rep sets)
Week 1 Workout 3: third session (still week 1, transitions to week 2 after this)
Week 2 Workout 3: transitions to week 3 after this
Week 3 Workout 1: 5/3/1 reps at 75/85/95% TM (last set AMRAP)
Week 3 Workout 3: transitions to week 4 after this
Week 4 Deload Workout 1: 5-rep sets at 40/50/60% TM (no AMRAP)
Week 4 Deload Workout 3: completes cycle 1, transitions to cycle 2 week 1
